Name: Blue Stem Yucca - 4 inch Pot - Easy to Grow House Plant
Natural: The Blue Yucca is native to Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and the eastern part of Mexico. Its flower, the izote, is the national flower of El Salvador. The Blue Yucca is an easy to grow houseplant that prefers sun or very bright, indirect light. It should be watered when on the dry side. With age it grows a thick stem.
